title: Summer Place Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTSL - CUSTOM designed home fully renovated to the studs - Central Seaside location with access to the private beach near East Ruskin pavilion - Pet friendly- preferred non-shedding dogs under 30 lbs - You will have a total of 10 RFID access cards for access to the private beaches in Seaside. - WIFI and streaming available on TVs - Fully stocked kitchen - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ONS: - There is an additional cost to use the 3 pools and fitness center in Seaside. The cost for this cottage is $84/day. Please alert us after booking should you wish to add the "Seaside Amenity Passes" to your reservation. -Vacation Cancellation Protection- Allows cancellation for any reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies refunded ($125 fee applies at booking) -Pet Fee $150 Summer Place is a custom 3-bedroom cottage that has traditional Seaside Charm on the outside and complete luxury on the inside. For those that choose not to wait in lines at local restaurants, Summer Place comes with a Chef’s kitchen with Wolf and Sub-Zero Appliances. Natural gas was brought in to run the six-burner range. Top of the line televisions and custom sound system in the living, dining and kitchen controlled by your phone and music app of your choice. There are 2 master bedrooms with King Beds, one down and one up. The kids' room is upstairs and has 3 Queen Beds. All of the mattresses are Heavenly™, by Westin Hotels. There are 4 full bathrooms and an outdoor shower that leads into one of the full bathrooms. The washer and dryer are commercial rated and ready for beach towels and the sand. The water system is filtered 4 times with a whole house water filtration system. Both air conditioning systems use ultraviolet light to eliminate bacteria and mold in the air for better air quality. A huge screened in front porch to relax, drink your coffee and watch the world go by. Best of all, private parking for three cars! ACCOMMODATIONS (sleeps 10) Main Floor: Bedroom 1: King bed, flat screen TV, ensuite bathroom with walk in shower and claw foot tub Shared hall Full Bath Laundry room with direct outside access Second Floor: Bedroom 2: King bed, flat screen TV, ensuite bathroom Bedroom 3: Kids room with 3 Queen Beds Hallway Bathroom with tub/shower combo ** WE ALLOW ONE SMALL, NON-SHEDDING DOG PER RENTAL ($250.00 SURCHARGE added after initial booking). Small is 30 pounds or less. No aggressive breeds. **Please note that the BBQ grill at the property does NOT work** ** There is an additional cost to use the 3 pools and fitness center in Seaside. This charge is optional with Sandpiper Vacation Rentals. The cost for this cottage is $84/day. Please alert us after booking should you wish to add the "Seaside Amenity Passes" to your reservation. Seaside requires the passes to be purchased for the entirety of your stay when ordered. * Additional fees are required to reserve Pickleball and Tennis courts paid directly to the Seaside amenity Center. * Seaside Chapel with Sunday services, Walkable Town Center from rental home including shopping, restaurants and upscale grocery market.
